subject: math
question:
已知向量组 $\pmb{\beta}_{1} = (0,1, - 1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ， $\pmb{\beta}_{2} = (a,2,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ， $\pmb{\beta}_{3} = (b,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 与向量组 $\alpha_{1} = (1,2, - 3)^{\mathrm{T}}$

$\alpha_{2} = (3,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}},\quad \alpha_{3} = (9,6, - 7)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 具有相同的秩，且 $\beta_{3}$ 可由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表示，求 $a,b$ 的值.

steps.text: 分析 易求得 $\operatorname{rank}(\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3) = 2$ ，由 $\operatorname{rank}(\beta_1, \beta_2, \beta_3) = 2$ 或 $\det(\beta_1, \beta_2, \beta_3) = 0$ 可得 $a$ 与 $b$ 的关系式；再由 $\beta_3$ 可由 $\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3$ 线性表示，从而可由其极大无关组线性表示，可再得 $a$ 与 $b$ 的一个关系式.

先求向量组 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 的秩. 对矩阵 $(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3})$ 做行初等变换

$$
\left(\begin{array}{c c c}1&3&9\\- 2&0&6\\- 3&1&- 7\end{array}\right)\rightarrow \left(\begin{array}{c c c}1&3&9\\0&- 6&- 1 2\\0&1 0&2 0\end{array}\right)\rightarrow \left(\begin{array}{c c c}1&3&9\\0&1&2\\0&0&0\end{array}\right),
$$

可见 $\operatorname{rank}(\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3) = 2$ ，且 $\alpha_1, \alpha_2$ 是向量组 $\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3$ 的一个极大无关组.

由已知条件 $\operatorname{rank}(\beta_1, \beta_2, \beta_3) = \operatorname{rank}(\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3) = 2$ ，所以

$$
\left| \left(\boldsymbol {\beta} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {3}\right) \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & a & b \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right| = 0 \Rightarrow a = 3 b.
$$

又 $\beta_{3}$ 可由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表示，从而可由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2}$ 线性表示，所以 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\beta_{3}$ 线性相关，可得

$$
\left| \left(\alpha_ {1} \alpha_ {2} \beta_ {3}\right) \right| = \left| \begin{array}{l l l} 1 & 3 & b \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ - 3 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right| = 0 \Rightarrow 2 b - 1 0 = 0.
$$

上面两式联立求解，得到 $b = 5, a = 15$ .
